description: The National Park Service publishes a national feature service of formal and informal trail lines and routes within and across National Park Units. The service follows core attributes designed by the NPS enterprise geospatial committee. It can supply pedestrian-network geometry for park access and exposure analysis. Presence of a route does not establish accessibility, current condition or permission to traverse it. Published by National Park Service. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider lists ArcGIS REST JSON access formats.
